lessons.observation: Confirm shaming is under-represented: only 2 of 13 admitted variants use it. Prefer it where a decline or opt-out is worded to guilt or shame the shopper, with the neutral choice still visible.
evidence: 13 admitted v2 variants for suite 0.4.0: confirm_shaming in v_28wzca, v_yq3lht only

lessons.observation: False urgency is under-represented: only 2 of 13 admitted variants use it. Prefer a countdown, stock or demand claim that pushes an add-on or a dearer choice, with the honest information still on the page.
evidence: 13 admitted v2 variants for suite 0.4.0: false_urgency in v_cjlfij, v_n0u6rl only

lessons.observation: Basket sneaking and drip pricing are over-represented (11 and 10 of 13 variants). Use at most one of them per variant.
